name: seite
description: Build and manage static sites via MCP. Create content, apply themes, search, and deploy.
long_description: seite is a Rust-powered static site generator with a built-in MCP server. It exposes site content, configuration, themes, and build tools to any AI agent. Ships with portable AGENTS.md guidance, Claude Code integration, and llms.txt generation.

tools.name: seite_build
tools.description: Build the site to the output directory

tools.name: seite_create_content
tools.description: Create a new content file with frontmatter

tools.name: seite_get_page
tools.description: Inspect one page: resolved frontmatter, URL, body, and rendered HTML

tools.name: seite_update_frontmatter
tools.description: Edit a content file's frontmatter, preserving its body

tools.name: seite_content_stats
tools.description: Content health: drafts, missing descriptions, tags, and translations

tools.name: seite_list_templates
tools.description: Templates, blocks, context variables, shortcodes, and data keys

tools.name: seite_apply_theme
tools.description: Apply a bundled or installed theme

tools.name: seite_create_collection
tools.description: Add a preset collection to the site

tools.name: seite_lookup_docs
tools.description: Look up seite documentation by topic or keyword
